about: A repository's development pipeline under Current: which checks its sessions run, `sessionChecks` in driver.json (FABRIC-PIPELINE1b, D192 point 4; the pipeline design §3.1): the table both twins hold, the CLI's driverconfig.ts and the driver's SessionChecks. Each `read` row is the value a file holds under `sessionChecks` (the file is `{"sessionChecks": <value>}`) and the map each twin reads from it: by repository, each name trimmed, a blank one passed over; each value text, trimmed and matched in any case against `light` or `heavy-at-end`, kept in that spelling; any other value is not read and shadows none; a name written twice in any case read where first readable, in its first spelling; anything but an object is no map. Absent is today's: a session runs as it did.

read.name: names and values read trimmed, a value in any case kept in its own spelling
a value that is no choice is not read
a name twice in any case is read where first readable, in its first spelling
a value that does not read shadows none
a blank name is passed over
anything but an object is no rule
